notes.title: Simplified Chinese translation
notes.content:
Hello, thanks to the incredible work of tangcuzhuzhu (糖醋猪猪) Autumn Spirit is now available in Simplified Chinese! 

Have a lovely day everyone!

notes.title: Italian translation fix
notes.content: Fixed two game breaking bug in the Italian translation.

notes.title: Translation fix + Women day
notes.content:
Hello, we fixed a couple of Ukrainian translation error. 

I am also taking the chance to say we are proudly participating to the Women's day sale with all our games, don't hesitate to take a look at our other creations! 

It's not completely obvious in Autumn Spirit since the story focus on other things, but discrimination toward women is very a strong focus for our team, and I am very happy to celebrate this month dedicated to fight for equality by being in this fest! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1652580/Imperial_Grace/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1967870/Ballads_at_Midnight/

notes.title: Translation patch
notes.content:
Hello, this last build, should fix some translation error! 
- Nathan name was not appearing in Spanish and French ; if you encountered this error and updating the build isn't enough, please start a new game, it should fix it. 
- A couple of lines was not translated into Ukrainian


We are sorry for the inconvenience, thank you for playing our game! 
Ayael
